description: Header file defining constexpr parsing logic for string formatting in Abseil's internal string formatting library, including enums, structs, and parsing functions for format specifiers.

classes.name: UnboundConversion
classes.description: Represents a single format conversion with properties like argument position, width, precision, flags, length modifier, and conversion character.

classes.name: ConvTag
classes.description: Helper class for fast lookup and checking of format conversion characters, length modifiers, and flags.

classes.name: ConvTagHolder
classes.description: Holds a static table of ConvTags for all possible characters, facilitating quick lookup.

methods.name: GetTagForChar
methods.description: Returns the ConvTag associated with a given character.

methods.name: CheckFastPathSetting
methods.description: Checks if the current conversion settings are suitable for fast path formatting.

methods.name: ParseDigits
methods.description: Parses a sequence of digits from the input.

methods.name: ConsumeConversion
methods.description: Parses a format conversion specifier from the input string.

methods.name: ConsumeUnboundConversion
methods.description: Parses a format specifier prefix, handling positional and non-positional conversions.
